answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A sparrow nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored hollow derivation. A ledge streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 7120 identities takes 55389 tokens, 40 operator hours and 9 days of exposure.
